about_the_game:
In a remote countryside of a certain world, the alchemist Lapis Fellucia continues her research in alchemy, struggling with a feeling of its limitations.

Her days start to change when she comes across a book titled "The Essence of Alchemy", setting her dreams into motion! At the same time, strange and mysterious phenomena begin to occur around the village. Armed with new knowledge and the company of peculiar and extraordinary people, she embarks on a journey toward her dreams.

Will her journey lead her to become a top-tier alchemist? Or perhaps—?!

Step into the role of a cute alchemist Lapis, who makes items, does naughty things, does naughty things to make items, and makes items to do naughty things!

Explore the world to gather materials, defeat monsters, and complete quests to fill your coin purse. Then, put your alchemical skills to work!

Battles aren’t just for survival, as they’re a key part of gathering rare ingredients. Each monster encounter comes with its own playful twists and potentially naughty outcomes.

Craft every item in the encyclopedia and help Lapis become a top-tier alchemist!

(Mostly-Optional) Battles

Enemies appear on the map, and you decide if you want to engage. If you prefer a story-focused experience, it's possible to complete the whole story without any regular battles. Just boss fights alone will get you strong enough to finish it.

Monsters will also scale with your level, keeping the battles challenging and engaging.

Jobs

As you progress through the game, you'll unlock the ability to take on jobs at the tavern. Since monsters drop very little money, working at the tavern becomes a reliable source of income. And the more jobs you complete, the more special events you’ll unlock!

Lewd Encounters

In addition to story-based CG scenes, you can also enjoy erotic encounters during battles. Each enemy features its own unique scenes, so be sure to experience them all!

Talking to people with heart icons will also trigger some special events, so be sure to explore!

Armor Break

As Lapis faces her opponents in battle, her armor will wear down, gradually revealing more and more of her body! If she's not careful, she'll end up roaming around completely naked!

Scene Recollection Room

In addition to the beautiful CGs, you can also watch and rewatch all the spicy scenes in the game involving the two lovely protagonists!

content_descriptors.notes: The game contains nudity and explicit depictions of sexual acts and bdsm between adults.
